# Python 实现：非 tidy 格式与 tidy 格式互相转换 {#sec-dtm-python}

本章用 Python 重现第 \@ref(sec-dtm) 章的内容：文档-术语矩阵（DTM）与 tidy 数据的互相转换、tf-idf 分析、词频随时间变化。Python 端用 **pandas** 做数据操作，**scikit-learn** 构建 DTM 和 tf-idf，**matplotlib** 绘图。

## 将 DTM 转为 tidy 格式

Python 中没有 R tm 包的 `DocumentTermMatrix` 类，但可以用 scipy 的稀疏矩阵和 sklearn 的 `CountVectorizer` 实现等价功能。从 tidy 格式构建 DTM，再转回 tidy 格式。

```{python}
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from scipy.sparse import csr_matrix

# 从 parquet 读取明清小说数据
books = pd.read_parquet("data/common/books.parquet")

import jieba
with open("data/stop_word_zh.utf8", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    stopwords = set(line.strip() for line in f if line.strip())

def segment_clean(text):
    if not isinstance(text, str):
        return []
    return [w for w in jieba.lcut(text) if w.strip() and w not in stopwords]

books["words"] = books["text"].apply(segment_clean)
tidy_books = books[["title", "words"]].explode("words").rename(columns={"words": "word"})
tidy_books = tidy_books[tidy_books["word"].str.len() > 0]

# 统计每个（书, 词）的出现次数
book_word_counts = tidy_books.groupby(["title", "word"]).size().reset_index(name="count")
book_word_counts.head(10)
```

从 tidy 格式构建 DTM（等价于 R 的 `cast_dtm()`）：

```{python}
# pivot 成宽表 = DTM
dtm = book_word_counts.pivot(index="title", columns="word", values="count").fillna(0)
print(f"DTM: {dtm.shape}")
dtm.iloc[:5, :5]
```

转回 tidy 格式（等价于 R 的 `tidy(dtm)`）：

```{python}
# melt 宽表回长表
dtm_tidy = dtm.reset_index().melt(id_vars="title", var_name="term", value_name="count")
dtm_tidy = dtm_tidy[dtm_tidy["count"] > 0]
dtm_tidy.head(10)
```

## 情感分析（从 DTM 开始）

```{python}
# 从 tidy DTM 开始，加入情感词典进行分析
nrc = pd.read_parquet("data/common/nrc.parquet")
bing_dict = nrc[nrc["sentiment"].isin(["positive", "negative"])]

dtm_sentiment = dtm_tidy.merge(bing_dict, left_on="term", right_on="word", how="inner")
dtm_sentiment.head(10)
```

```{python}
#| label: fig-apsentimentplot-py
#| fig-cap: "各书中正面和负面情感的词（Python）"
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib

matplotlib.rcParams["font.sans-serif"] = ["Noto Sans CJK SC", "Microsoft YaHei", "SimHei"]
matplotlib.rcParams["axes.unicode_minus"] = False

sent_counts = dtm_sentiment.groupby(["title", "sentiment", "term"])["count"].sum().reset_index()
# 取每种情感 top 15
top_words = (
    sent_counts.groupby(["title", "sentiment"])
    .apply(lambda g: g.nlargest(15, "count"))
    .reset_index(drop=True)
)

titles = sorted(top_words["title"].unique())
fig, axes = plt.subplots(3, 2, figsize=(12, 12))
for ax, title in zip(axes.flat, titles):
    sub = top_words[top_words["title"] == title].sort_values("count")
    colors = ["#d62728" if s == "negative" else "#2ca02c" for s in sub["sentiment"]]
    ax.barh(sub["term"], sub["count"], color=colors)
    ax.set_title(title[:8], fontsize=9)
    ax.set_xlabel("Count")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

## 科技文本的 tf-idf

使用科技文本数据集（stem），计算 tf-idf 并找出每部作品最具代表性的词。

```{python}
stem = pd.read_parquet("data/common/stem.parquet")
stem["words"] = stem["text"].apply(lambda t: jieba.lcut(t) if isinstance(t, str) else [])
tidy_stem = stem[["author", "words"]].explode("words").rename(columns={"words": "word"})
tidy_stem = tidy_stem[tidy_stem["word"].str.len() > 0]

# 移除纯数字/英文词
num_re = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z0-9零一二三四五六七八九十百千萬]+$")
tidy_stem = tidy_stem[~tidy_stem["word"].str.match(num_re)]

# tf-idf
stem_counts = tidy_stem.groupby(["author", "word"]).size().reset_index(name="n")
n_docs = stem_counts["author"].nunique()
docs_per_word = stem_counts.groupby("word")["author"].nunique()
stem_counts["tf"] = stem_counts["n"] / stem_counts.groupby("author")["n"].transform("sum")
stem_counts["idf"] = np.log(n_docs / docs_per_word.reindex(stem_counts["word"]).values)
stem_counts["tf_idf"] = stem_counts["tf"] * stem_counts["idf"]
stem_counts = stem_counts.sort_values("tf_idf", ascending=False)

# top 10
stem_counts.head(10)
```

## 年度词频变化

对《红楼梦》英译本，计算词频随时间（行号索引）的变化。

```{python}
import re

hongloumeng_en = pd.read_parquet("data/common/hongloumeng_en.parquet")
hongloumeng_en["linenumber"] = range(1, len(hongloumeng_en) + 1)

# 按 100 行分段
hongloumeng_en["section"] = hongloumeng_en["linenumber"] // 100

def tokenize_en(text):
    if not isinstance(text, str):
        return []
    return [w.lower() for w in nltk.word_tokenize(text) if w.isalpha()]

import nltk
hongloumeng_en["tokens"] = hongloumeng_en["text"].apply(tokenize_en)
section_words = hongloumeng_en[["section"]].copy().assign(word=hongloumeng_en["tokens"]).explode("word")
section_words = section_words[section_words["word"].str.len() > 0]

# 词频
section_counts = section_words.groupby(["section", "word"]).size().reset_index(name="count")
section_totals = section_words.groupby("section").size().reset_index(name="total")
section_counts = section_counts.merge(section_totals, on="section")
section_counts["proportion"] = section_counts["count"] / section_counts["total"]
```

```{python}
#| label: fig-yearterm-py
#| fig-cap: "词频随时间的变化（Python）"
target_words = ["love", "death", "life", "house", "family", "child"]
sub = section_counts[section_counts["word"].isin(target_words)]

fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(12, 6))
for ax, word in zip(axes.flat, target_words):
    wsub = sub[sub["word"] == word].sort_values("section")
    ax.scatter(wsub["section"], wsub["proportion"], s=8, alpha=0.5)
    # 简单移动平均
    if len(wsub) > 3:
        wsub_sorted = wsub.sort_values("section")
        wsub_sorted["ma"] = wsub_sorted["proportion"].rolling(3, center=True).mean()
        ax.plot(wsub_sorted["section"], wsub_sorted["ma"], color="steelblue")
    ax.set_title(word)
    ax.set_ylabel("% frequency")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

## 使用 scikit-learn 构建 DTM

```{python}
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import CountVectorizer, TfidfVectorizer

# 使用空格连接的词作为输入
corpus = books.groupby("title")["words"].apply(lambda ws: " ".join([" ".join(w) for w in ws])).reset_index()

vectorizer = CountVectorizer(tokenizer=lambda x: x.split(), lowercase=False)
dtm_sk = vectorizer.fit_transform(corpus["words"])
print(f"DTM: {dtm_sk.shape}")

# 转为稀疏矩阵（等价于 R 的 cast_sparse()）
from scipy.sparse import issparse
print(f"是否稀疏: {issparse(dtm_sk)}")
print(f"非零元素比例: {dtm_sk.nnz / (dtm_sk.shape[0] * dtm_sk.shape[1]):.4f}")
```

```{python}
# tf-idf（等价于 R 的 bind_tf_idf()）
tfidf_vec = TfidfVectorizer(tokenizer=lambda x: x.split(), lowercase=False)
tfidf_sk = tfidf_vec.fit_transform(corpus["words"])
feature_names = tfidf_vec.get_feature_names_out()

# 每本书 top 10 词
for i, title in enumerate(corpus["title"]):
    scores = tfidf_sk[i].toarray().flatten()
    top_idx = scores.argsort()[-10:][::-1]
    top_words = [(feature_names[j], scores[j]) for j in top_idx]
    print(f"\n{title}:")
    for w, s in top_words:
        print(f"  {w}: {s:.4f}")
```

## R vs Python 对比

| 任务 | R | Python |
|---|---|---|
| DTM 构建 | `cast_dtm()` / tm `DocumentTermMatrix` | `CountVectorizer` / `pivot()` |
| tidy 转 DTM | `cast_dtm(document, term, count)` | `pivot(index, columns, values)` |
| DTM 转 tidy | `tidy(AssociatedPress)` | `melt()` 过滤非零 |
| tf-idf | `bind_tf_idf()` | `TfidfVectorizer` / 手动计算 |
| 稀疏矩阵 | `cast_sparse()` | `scipy.sparse.csr_matrix` |
| 词频趋势 | `geom_smooth()` | `rolling().mean()` + scatter |
| 绘图 | ggplot2 `facet_wrap()` | matplotlib subplots |

Python 的 sklearn 提供了高效的 DTM/tfidf 构建，pandas 的 pivot/melt 可以在 tidy 和宽格式间自由转换。R 的 tidytext 更强调"tidy 数据流"的连贯性，Python 则更灵活但也更分散。
